clarified_intent.description: Independently validate that the completed Next.js App Router change satisfies its bounded plan acceptance criteria and can proceed to adversarial review without delaying or mutating the frozen React rc.1 lane.

specification.constraint_source: KBD plan and task-specific constraints because .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md is absent

target_state.description: A reproducible QA bundle with zero blocking violations, explicit limits, intact React-first staging, and no registry mutation claim.
success_criteria: Every Next.js plan and OpenSpec criterion maps to direct evidence.
Packed-package and workspace-source boundaries remain explicit.
SSR, hydration, mutation, realtime, accessibility, screenshot, and trace requirements pass.
Coverage, exports, skills, docs, Changesets, and OpenSpec agree.
Security and unresolved platform/manual limits remain explicit.
React rc.1 can stage independently while this change waits for a later prerelease.

unknowns: External npm trusted-publisher and protected-environment authority cannot be proven by repository artifacts.
Firefox, WebKit, mobile browser, static/ISR rendering, and live hosted services are outside this change.
The stable release SHA and remaining showcase/docs work do not yet exist.
